C1002.title: CF Ranked Match Penalty Notice for Intentional Feeding and Boosting (Batch 2)
C1002.summary: On March 16, 2022, CrossFire officials issued a second batch of penalty notices targeting malicious behaviors in the S20 ranked season, such as intentional feeding and boosting services. Violating players faced rank point resets and escalating competitive bans, with the maximum penalty being a 180-day ban and account suspension.
